Will it work with my setup?

Supported assets, how it connects, and what you need to get started.

BitcoinEthereumSolanaUSB-C
Coins and networks

VAULT supports Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana. Network fees are paid separately when you send.

Computers and phones

Connects over USB-C to computers and phones with a USB-C port, using the VAULT companion app.

How it connects

The device connects over USB-C, and a braided USB-C cable is included in the box.

What you need besides the device

The VAULT companion app and a device with a USB-C port. Recovery cards are included for writing down your recovery phrase.

What it protects, and what it doesn’t

Plain-language summary. It reduces risk. It does not remove it.

What it protects

Your private keys are created and stored on the device, not on your computer or phone. Transactions are signed inside the device, so malware on your computer cannot read your keys.

Your recovery phrase is your responsibility

You write down a recovery phrase during setup. Anyone with it can take your funds, and if you lose it and the device, we cannot restore access. Never type it into a website, a chat or a form. VAULT will never ask for it.

If you lose the device

Your funds are not on the device. You can restore them onto a new one with your recovery phrase. Without the phrase, they cannot be recovered.

What it cannot stop

It cannot stop you from approving a scam transaction or visiting a fake site. Read the address and amount on the device screen before you confirm.
